lines.en: I walk at you without ever stopping.
I do not detour; I walk through trees.

lines.zh: 我的脚步间隔始终一样。
lines.en: The gap between my steps never changes.

lines.zh: 我像 Pseudo 那样朝你压过来。
lines.en: I come at you the way Pseudo does.
The grass does not stir where I pass.
I started walking a long way back.

lines.zh: 我一点点缩小这个距离。
lines.en: I shrink the distance bit by bit.
I neither run nor stop.
My shadow is shorter than yours.
I walk this straight line.

lines.zh: 我走过来的时候没有声音。
lines.en: I come on without a sound.
I stand with my head hanging low.
I do not move, and you know I am here.
There is no breathing, really.

lines.zh: 创造者在墙后等你转身。
lines.en: The creator waits behind the wall for you to turn.
I hold this angle.

lines.zh: 我一动不动地看了很久。
lines.en: I have watched without moving for a long time.

lines.zh: 我身上的东西在慢慢晃。
lines.en: Something on me sways slowly.
I stay in the corner and never move.
I am patient, more than you.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙，尽量不占地方。
lines.en: I press to the wall, taking little space.
I know your patience will break first.
I let my hands hang at my sides.
I wait for you to finish counting torches.
I raise a face without features.

lines.zh: 我连自己的形状都没有。
lines.en: I don't even have a shape.
I understand why you will not look long.
I tilt my head onto my shoulder.
My face is a finger from the wall.
I hold still in the corner of your eye.
Every time you turn, I am there.
I slowly raise one hand.

lines.zh: 我的样子让你想起某个东西。
lines.en: My shape reminds you of something.
I am indeed looking at you.
You never heard me approach.

lines.zh: 我站在你刚才站的位置。
lines.en: I stand where you just stood.
I lower my head close.
You smell an old wall.

lines.zh: 没有名字的它，只朝你走。
lines.en: Nameless, and it only walks toward you.
I am not alive; I resemble it.
My shadow clings to your back.
You are looking at me at last.
I pause, then keep walking.
I tilt my head and watch you.
My outline blurs for an instant.
I withdraw a short step.
My body thins a little.
I reset my pose.

lines.zh: 你打中的地方慢慢恢复。
lines.en: Where you hit me slowly recovers.
I slowly lift my head.
I have no interest in it.

lines.zh: 你把东西举起来，我没动。
lines.en: You hold it up and I do not move.
It has no smell to me.
I go around your offered hand.
I knock it over.

lines.zh: 那东西在地上滚，我不理。
lines.en: It rolls on the ground and I ignore it.
I would rather watch you keep walking.
I lift a hand and it drops.

lines.zh: 你不该把注意分到别处。
lines.en: You should not let your attention drift.
You hit me and I do not give.
My body is hard and light.

lines.zh: 你从我身上穿过去，什么都没摸到。
lines.en: You pass through and feel nothing.
The impact throws off cold.

lines.zh: 我的头歪了一下，正回来。
lines.en: My head tips and rights itself.

lines.zh: 我的手从你手臂上蹭过。
lines.en: My hand drags across your arm.

lines.zh: 我的影子压在你身上不动。
lines.en: My shadow settles on you and stays.
You hear a very light sound.
I barely give a single step.
Two of them stand side by side.
We do not converse.

lines.zh: 它的头歪向一边，我也歪。
lines.en: Its head tilts; so does mine.
We turn to the same side together.

lines.zh: 我们的影子在墙角连上。
lines.en: Our shadows join in the corner.

lines.zh: 我们并排往同一个方向走。
lines.en: We walk the same way side by side.
It raises a hand; I raise mine.
Neither of us stops.
One block apart from each other.
We face each other without faces.
I bend and slowly take it.
I close my hand around it.
I hold it to the light.
I put it inside me.
It grows cold in my hand.
I look, then throw it aside.

lines.zh: 我拖着它挪过两格地板。
lines.en: I drag it across two blocks of floor.
I press it against the wall.
I hold it and keep walking at you.
I put it back, gently.
I stop and lift my head.
I am already walking.
This is not chasing; it is approaching.
I recognize your outline.
I begin coming this way.
I have no reason, only a direction.
I want you out of here, always.

lines.zh: 我的脚步忽然有了快慢。
lines.en: My steps suddenly have a rhythm.
You have been singled out.
I raise a hand slightly.

lines.zh: 这个距离对我来说太远。
lines.en: This distance is too far for me.
I begin closing it.
The wall behind you has no exit.
I walk at you and will not deviate.
This area is mine to walk.
You are included in the count.
I keep walking at you.
You back away, and I follow.
I never speed up, and never fall behind.
You climb the window; I come through the door.
I am three blocks behind you.
You hide under the bed; I crouch.
My footsteps pause and resume.
You can hear it, not see it.
I go around your torches.
You go up; I am at the stairwell.

lines.zh: 我一直保持同样的速度。
lines.en: I keep exactly the same pace.
Your hands are already trembling.
I draw nearer to your door.
You are between a corner and a wall.

lines.zh: 越来越近，我从不跑，只走。
lines.en: Closer and closer; I never run, only walk.
No hurry; you will tire.
My shadow reaches the doorway first.
You hear me standing outside.
I lay a hand on your chest.
My fingers rake your face.
I slam my whole body into you.
I press you against the wall.

lines.zh: 我的手抓住你的手腕，很凉。
lines.en: My hand closes on your wrist, cold.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，但你走不动了。
lines.en: It is not heavy, but you cannot move.
My head drops to your shoulder.
My weight pins you.
I raise a knee into your gut.

lines.zh: 我的手指在你脖子上停住。
lines.en: My fingers stop at your throat.

lines.zh: 你把我推开，我又贴上来。
lines.en: You shove me off and I press back.
I bring a hand down at your face.
My body feels like cold cloth.
You should not have come this close.
After the strike I stand where I was.
You pull away; I follow slowly.
A shadow appears in the corner.
I begin to exist, quietly.

lines.zh: 这里本没有这样的角度。
lines.en: There was no such angle here.

lines.zh: 你听见某处有一下轻响。
lines.en: You hear a single light sound.

lines.zh: 我站在你刚离开的房间。
lines.en: I stand in the room you just left.
The light shrinks an inch.
A layer of cold enters the air.
I am squeezed out of the corner.
An outline slowly comes clear.
My shadow climbs the wall first.

lines.zh: 你在屋里感到多了一道注视。
lines.en: You feel one more gaze in the room.

lines.zh: 我出现时没有惊动任何东西。
lines.en: Nothing stirred when I appeared.
The dark behind the door thickens.

lines.zh: 我开始站着，然后开始走。
lines.en: I begin standing, then begin walking.

lines.zh: 这一格空间多了一个人形。
lines.en: This one block of space gained a figure.

lines.zh: 你没有听见脚步，但我知道。
lines.en: You heard no steps; I know.
The thing in the corner moved.
I am only one room away.
I arrive the instant the light dies.

lines.zh: 旧版本的空气又回来了。
lines.en: The air of an old version returns.

lines.zh: 火里我的形状抖了一下。
lines.en: My shape shudders inside the fire.
I hit the ground and briefly scatter.

lines.zh: 水灌进来，我的轮廓软了。
lines.en: Water floods in and my outline softens.

lines.zh: 爆光里我整个人没了又回来。
lines.en: In the blast's light I vanish and return.

lines.zh: 箭穿过我，留下一个小洞。
lines.en: An arrow passes through, leaving a small hole.
That force makes me fully visible.

lines.zh: 我不会饿，只是越来越淡。
lines.en: I do not hunger; I only fade.
Lightning lights up my whole shape.

lines.zh: 脚下一空，我掉得没有声音。
lines.en: The floor gives way and I fall silently.
